title: The Forgotten Veil Revisited
author: Bram Marchetti
blurb: Rafael Amberdale, an exiled storm-caller, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
